title: implement ReLU

atoms.evidence: class ReLU(nn.Module): with only forward defined (no __init__/super needed for trivial Module)
solution: return t.maximum(x, t.tensor(0.0)) — the canonical elementwise max-with-zero

atoms_in_seed_but_not_actually_present.reason: seed predicted this for exercise 0 but the maximum-with-scalar-tensor here doesn't exercise broadcasting in any meaningful sense; t.tensor(0.0) is a 0-D scalar

notes: Trivial 2-atom exercise — the minimal possible Module (no __init__, no parameters, no extra_repr). Confirms that the Module-spine atoms (nn-parameter-wrap, module-extra-repr) are NOT universal — they only apply when there's state to declare. Below the 4-7 band but that's appropriate for a deliberately trivial first exercise.
